findings.finding: Steam concurrent-player data for the reported quarter (Jul-Sep 2026) shows back catalogue near the prior run-rate. Wuchang averaged 1,679 / 1,962 / 1,096 against 1,415-1,501 in Apr-Jun. Assetto Corsa averaged about 8,818 against about 9,717. ACC averaged about 2,179 against 2,252. AC EVO averaged about 717 against 897, and AC Rally about 561 against 590. This points to Q1 revenue close to the ~EUR 19-20m quarterly back-catalogue run-rate, inside the company's 'H1 mainly back catalogue' guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY25 (a back-catalogue quarter, released 14 Nov 2024 evening): -2.49% next day. Q1 FY26 (Wuchang launch, revenue doubled): +9.84%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the market was told H1 is back-catalogue. The proxy only says no visible collapse or spike. If the market expected collapse, the stock's -23% since 25 Sep would show it, but that drop has no sourced cause. A proxy, Steam-only (about 94% of revenue is digital, but consoles are invisible here), so it is kept small.

findings.finding: The company has beaten its own net-financial-position guidance at three consecutive prints. FY26 closed at +EUR 3.3m against an expected net debt. The 9M FY26 figure was described as 'superiore alle attese'. At Q1 FY26 it guided a return to net debt. It now guides net debt for the first three quarters of FY27, so a Q1 NFP better than feared is a modest upside lean. The guided net debt is driven by the EUR 21.5m Wuchang sequel commitment and H2 launch spending.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY26 (NFP above expectations, guide for revenue decline): +3.12% next day. 9M FY26 (NFP 'superiore alle attese'): +3.92% next day.
findings.original_quote: La Posizione finanziaria netta rettificata è positiva per 4,2 milioni (5,8 milioni al netto dell'effetto IFRS 16), superiore alle attese e sensibilmente migliorata rispetto all'indebitamento netto per 16,5 milioni al 30 giugno 2025. (Teleborsa, 13 May 2026: adjusted NFP positive EUR 4.2m, above expectations.)
findings.why_not_priced: An inference from the company's habit, not a number. If it were priced, the drop since 25 Sep would have needed an offsetting cause.

findings.finding: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement, a centrepiece of the FY27 H2 slate, was delayed to an undated 2027 slot on 26 Aug 2026. FY27 ends 30 Jun 2027, so the guide rests on a launch with no date. Any timing update in the release (a date before or after June 2027) moves the FY27 revenue guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 FY25 (March 2025, outlook disappointment): -16.0% next day. FY25 (Sept 2025): -6.37%. H1 FY26 (March 2026): -6.39%. Guidance lines move this name the most.
findings.why_not_priced: The delay itself is public and predates the September guide, which still listed Bloodstained in H2, so it is priced. The finding is only the asymmetry: no date is known, ArtPlay says development is in its final stages, and a slip beyond June 2027 would cut the guide. Small, because nothing sourced says it will slip.

lessons_applied: 'Understatement / size the move on what is new': abs_move_pct raised from 4.5 to 5.0. The quarter's numbers are not pre-released, turnover is thin ($126k/day), there are two analysts, and the name's own next-day reactions have a median of about 5%. Held below the 7% new-numbers base because the guide is most likely reiterated (2.3% base).

'A finding inside what the company guided is worth ~0': the Steam back-catalogue finding was cut from +0.2 to +0.1 and the YoY-headline finding from -0.3 to -0.1, since both land inside the September 'H1 mainly back catalogue, revenue down' guide
